assumptions.statement: The submitted SITE_BOUNDARY and three KEY_AREA polygons are organizer-provided provisional geometry, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived areas, ratios and alignments require full recalculation when official polygons are published or supplied.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, utilities, fire safety, heritage controls and engineering constraints are not complete in the public package.
assumptions.impact: No statutory FAR, height, setback, demolition, road-redline or engineering conclusion is claimed.

assumptions.statement: Existing-building survey and parcel ownership data are insufficient for site-specific retain/renovate/demolish classification.
assumptions.impact: Building GeoJSON contains only reversible conceptual AI Commons prototypes; existing building actions remain pending survey.

assumptions.statement: City Pull Request governance, contribution ledger and annual event system are proposed operating mechanisms, not commitments by any authority or landholder.
assumptions.impact: Pilot governance must be co-designed with public bodies, communities, enterprises and privacy/legal reviewers before implementation.
